name: glideslope-monorepo
description: Glideslope design system: a Vue 3 + Reka UI design system with a Tailwind v4 foundation.

scripts.storybook: vp run --filter "@wingbrace/glideslope^..." build && vp run --filter @wingbrace/glideslope storybook
scripts.playground: vp run --filter "playground^..." build && vp run --filter playground dev
scripts.verify: vp run build && vp check && vp run typecheck && vp test run
